title: Employee is fatally injured after aerial lift falls into bod
narrative: At approximately 5:00 p.m. on February 23, 2025, Employee #1 was working from a spider basket aerial lift. After completing part of the task, Employee #1 prepared to relocate to another area, which required additional rigging equipment, including a 21-inch cable wire with 5/16-inch hooks. A temporary line was used during the relocation. While the basket was being repositioned, it fell approximately 80 feet into a body of water. Employee #1 was fatally injured.

title: Employee is fatally injured while topping tree
narrative: At 3:45 p.m. on February 23, 2025, Employee #1 was working as a laborer for a tree service company and was atop a tree approximately 30 feet from the ground conducting chainsaw cutting operations to remove the top section of the tree. Employee #1 was held in place by spurs, a lanyard wrapped around the tree, and a lifeline attached to another tree. During this operation, the integrity of the wood at the base of the tree become compromised and began to fall. The employee was pulled down with the tree. Mid-fall, the employee grabbed his lifeline which snapped the branch of the tree it was attached to. The falling tree then made contact with the ground with the employee landing on the fallen tree. The employee was fatally injured.

title: Employee is fatally injured when caught between container, b
narrative: At 12:25 p.m. on February 24, 2025, Employee #1 was working as a roofer at a warehouse worksite and was engaged in roof removal. Coworker #2 (driver) was operating a roll-off truck, Employee #1 was standing between the roll-off truck and the west side of the building in front of loading dock removing roofing debris from the ground around the loading dock. Coworker #2 repositioned the truck and requested that the area where the container would be placed be cleared of debris. Employee #1 and Coworker #3 gave a thumbs-up indicating the area was clear. Coworker #2 began lowering the container. The hook securing the container detached during the lowering process. Coworker #2 reattached the cable, lifted the container back onto the truck, and discovered Employee #1 lying on the ground behind the truck. The employee was caught between the 40-yard roll-off container and building. Employee #1 sustained fatal injuries.

title: Employee is fatally injured while spotting delivery truck dr
narrative: At 1:00 p.m. on February 22, 2025, Employee #1 was working as a sales driver for a furniture store and was assigned to deliver furniture to a residence with a coworker. The employee was guiding the coworker backing up the delivery truck. The coworker got out of the truck to see how much space they had between the truck and the home. The coworker had placed the vehicle in reverse instead of neutral. The coworker attempted to jump back in to slam on the brakes, but instead stepped on the gas striking the employee. The employee sustained fatal injuries.

title: Two employees are fatally injured in suspended scaffold fall
narrative: At 12:00 p.m. on February 22, 2025, Employee #1 and Employee #2 were working approximately 250 feet above the ground while repairing blades on a windmill. The workers ascended on a suspended scaffold that indicated the primary cable rigging was only attached at one end. This allowed the sling to slip free as the scaffold ascended causing the full weight of the scaffold to transfer to the second cable. The secondary cable should have acted as a brake and locked the scaffold in place. However, the scaffold fell approximately 20 feet before the secondary cable seized and snapped due to the momentum, causing the scaffold to fall. Both employees sustained fatal injuries.

title: Employee is fatally struck by falling tree while working fro
narrative: At approximately 10:30 a.m. on February 22, 2025, Employee #1 was cutting the top portion of a 40-foot tree while working from an elevated truck-mounted bucket. During the operation, the tree fell toward the bucket and struck the employee. Employee #1 sustained fatally injuries.

title: Employee is fatally injured while on ladder securing bolts o
narrative: At 11:00 a.m. on February 22, 2025, Employee #1 was laying out walkway handrails on the floor in preparation for installation on top of the coldbox project. While on a ladder checking and securing bolts on the handrails, the employee was struck by an overhead crane. The employee sustained fatal injuries.

title: Employee is fatally injured in sandblast tank explosion
narrative: At 2:49 p.m. on February 22, 2025, Employee #1 was standing on a 5-foot ladder inspecting a sandblasting tank while refilling it and checking hose connections. An unidentified substance inside the tank exploded, causing Employee #1 to be thrown from the ladder. Employee #1 was fatally injured.

title: One employee is fatally injured and another employee is inju
narrative: At 1:00 p.m. on February 21, 2025, employees were unloading palletized granite slabs from the back of a truck using a forklift. The granite slabs began to lean, and three employees attempted to correct the hazard. The slabs then fell, pinning one employee between the fallen granite and another pallet. The employee sustained fatal injuries and another employee was seriously injured and hospitalized.

title: Employee is fatally injured while leveling vertical mullion
narrative: At 8:30 a.m. on February 21, 2025, Employee #1 was working as a construction trades helper for a general building contractor and was ensuring that a vertical mullion was level. Employee #1 was attempting to hand a tool to a coworker who was on an aerial lift. The mullion broke free and the employee fell, sustaining fatal injuries.

title: Employee is fatally injured by falling steel door
narrative: At 8:34 a.m. on February 20, 2025, Employee #1 and coworkers were closing a steel door mounted on a railing system with track wheels. While manually adjusting the door, one of the track wheels came off the rail, causing the door to jackknife. Three employees were on the door attempting to realign it when the door fell backward, trapping Employee #1 in the middle. Employee #1 sustained fatal injuries.

title: Employee is fatally injured while digging trench to find foo
narrative: At 9:00 a.m. on February 20,2025, Employee #1 and Coworker #1 were working as masons and had begun to manually dig a trench with a shovel while trying to find a concrete footer attached to the foundation of a house. They were instructed to dig down until they found the footer and then to continue lengthwise. Employee #1 and Coworker #1 remained in the trench and continued digging. Employee #1 was at the left side of the trench, and Coworker #1 was on the right side. The depth on the left side was approximately 8 to 9 feet and the depth on the right side was approximately 5 feet. The left side of the trench collapsed causing dirt to engulf Employee #1. The employee was fatally injured.

title: Employee is fatally injured by rolling debris
narrative: At 3:00 p.m. on February 20, 2025, a rigging crew was walking up a road line to reach the landing area. A large chunk of wood broke loose from the landing and rolled downhill, striking an employee. The employee sustained fatal injuries.

title: Employee is fatally injured while loading vehicles inside sh
narrative: At 1:00 p.m. on February 20, 2025, Employee #1 was tasked with loading vehicles into another container. While attaching metal wires to secure the vehicle wheels inside the container, one of the wires snapped, causing a vehicle to fall and strike Employee #1. Employee #1 was fatally injured.

title: Employee is fatally injured after being struck by front-end
narrative: At 8:38 a.m. on February 19, 2025, Employee #1 was walking at a worksite when he was struck by a front-end loader. The employee sustained fatal injuries.

title: Employee is fatally injured while operating reach truck
narrative: At 4:48 p.m. on February 19, 2025, Employee #1 was operating a reach truck to remove a pallet from a storage rack approximately 22 feet high. While maneuvering the reach truck within the aisle, the employee leaned out of the safety cage area. Employee #1 became caught between the rear vertical overhead guard support and a lower rack metal support post behind him. Employee #1 sustained fatal injuries.

title: Employee is fatally injured in fall from metal structure
narrative: At 7:27 p.m. on February 19, 2025, Employee #1 was installing decking on the upper level of a metal structure. The employee fell and sustained fatal injuries.

title: Employee sustains fatal injuries when struck by falling tree
narrative: At 11:00 a.m. on February 18, 2025, Employee #1 was working for a site preparation contractor and was felling an approximate 5-foot-diameter 80-foot-tall poplar tree. Employee #1 was attempting to move away from the tree when he became tangled in the roots and underbrush. Employee #1 fell into the path of the tree and was struck, sustaining fatal injuries.

title: Employee dies after sudden collapse while working
narrative: At 2:34 p.m. on February 18, 2025, Employee #1 was placing labels on oranges on the orange line when the employee suddenly collapsed. The cause of death was determined to be a natural causes. This is not covered by OSHA.

title: Employee is fatally injured while putting out signs along hi
narrative: On February 18, 2025, Employee #1 was a surveyor working on a crew with three coworkers. The crew was tasked with surveying land for an expansion project near an interstate highway. The employee was working alone, standing behind Coworker #1's truck, setting up work zone signs on the shoulder of the road. An 18-wheeler driving by Employee #1, experienced a tire failure, causing a tire to detach from the vehicle. The tire struck Employee #1 and hit the work vehicle parked on the side of the road. Employee #1 sustained fatal injuries.

title: Employee is fatally injured when installing insulation on ro
narrative: At 2:00 p.m. on February 18, 2025, Employee #1 was working for a roofing contractor and was installing insulation on a roof. Employee #1 fell from a 21-foot elevation Employee #1 sustained fatal injuries.

title: Employee is fatally injured when railcar implodes
narrative: At 8:15 a.m. on February 17, 2025, Employee #1 was connecting a steam hose to the steam valve of railcar to reheat and pump soybean oil. After partially opening the steam valve to allow gradual heating, the railcar suddenly imploded and collapsed downward, striking the employee. The employee sustained fatal injuries.

title: Employee is fatally injured while servicing PTO shaft
narrative: At 8:45 a.m. on February 17, 2025, Employee #1 was attempting to pump propane into a stationary tank that supplied energy to a church located at the site. The power take-off (PTO) shaft on the pumping truck reportedly would not disengage, prompting the employee to go underneath the truck to attempt to dislodge it. While performing this task, the employee's coat became entangled in the rotating PTO shaft. The employee sustained fatal injuries.

title: Employee is fatally injured during tower climb
narrative: At 6:30 a.m. on February 17, 2025, Employee #1 was ascending a communication tower to assist with the installation of a new telephone communication dish. While climbing, the employee lost footing and fell. Employee #1 sustained fatal injuries.

title: Employee sustains fatal injuries, falls installing drywall
narrative: At 12:00 p.m. on February 17, 2025, Employee #1 was working as a drywall installer and was installing metal frames and drywall. The employee was working from a 7-foot ladder installing fire tape and drywall when he fell sustaining fatal injuries.
